description: Enjoy the scenery, stop making your life difficult #LifeByDesign #nervoussystemhealing #simplelife
transcript: Things do not have to be as difficult as we make them. We often add too many ingredients to simple recipes. We make life way too complex. There are so many parts of our lives that should move and flow and move and ease. And we add too much thought into it. And when it comes to releasing control. Releasing control is allowing flow to do its part. It's allowing your thoughts to do their part. When it's time to take action, it's time to take action. But there are so many moments where we can sit back and enjoy the scenery. Learn how to relax. Learn how to live with ease. It does not need to be as difficult as we make it.
